title: Intelligence community split on Havana syndrome
place_text: US intelligence community, State Department, CIA

tellings.quote:
But I think there was not unonymity
within the community, the intelligence
community on what was going on.

plain: On a podcast episode with a former head of the NSA, the US agency that intercepts communications, a guest named Eric Hazeline talked about Havana syndrome, a set of unexplained illnesses reported by US diplomats and intelligence officers. Hazeline says that the US spy agencies, the State Department and the CIA did not agree on what was causing it. If true, it would mean that even inside government nobody was sure what was hurting these people.
